name: js_where_template_literal_interp
reason: $where given a JS template literal with ${term} interpolation executes attacker-influenced server-side JavaScript.

name: js_where_string_concat
reason: $where built by concatenating a string literal with a variable is the same server-side JS injection as template interpolation.

name: pymongo_where_fstring
reason: pymongo $where given a Python f-string interpolates untrusted data into server-side JavaScript.

name: pymongo_where_concat
reason: pymongo $where built via string concatenation with a variable is the same server-side JS injection.

name: js_raw_req_body_findone
reason: Passing the whole req.body into findOne() lets an attacker send {"username":{"$ne":""}} to bypass the intended match.

name: js_raw_req_query_find
reason: Passing the whole req.query into find() lets an attacker inject MongoDB operators via query-string bracket syntax.

name: js_raw_req_params_find
reason: Passing the whole req.params into find() is the same raw-object operator-injection shape as req.body/req.query.

name: js_raw_req_body_replaceone
reason: replaceOne() accepts a query filter as its first argument; passing req.body lets an attacker inject an operator filter and replace an unintended document.

name: pymongo_raw_request_json
reason: Passing request.json directly into pymongo's find() lets an attacker submit an operator object in place of any field.

name: pymongo_raw_request_get_json
reason: request.get_json() passed straight into find_one() is the same raw-object operator-injection shape.

name: js_property_no_cast_username
reason: An un-cast req.body.username filter value lets an attacker send {"username":{"$gt":""}} as JSON to match any user.

name: js_property_no_cast_params
reason: An un-cast req.params.id filter value carries the same operator-injection risk as an un-cast req.body property.

name: js_regex_bare_request_body
reason: $regex given a bare req.body property enables boolean/blind character-by-character extraction (SKILL.md Steps 3-4).

name: js_regex_bare_request_query
reason: $regex given a bare req.query property is the same blind-extraction primitive as req.body.

name: js_json_parse_query_filter
reason: JSON.parse(req.query.filter) deserializes raw request text into an arbitrary query object, bypassing normal body-parser typing.

name: js_json_parse_body_filter
reason: JSON.parse(req.body.q) is the same raw-request-to-query-object primitive as JSON.parse(req.query...).

name: clean_string_cast_property
reason: An explicit String() cast forces the value to a primitive, closing off the {"$gt": ""}-shaped operator-injection payload.

name: clean_parseint_eq_property
reason: $eq given a parseInt()-cast value is validated/typed, not a bare request property.

name: clean_number_eq_property
reason: $eq given a Number()-cast value is validated/typed, not a bare request property.

name: clean_static_where
reason: A $where that is a fully static string literal with no variable has nothing for an attacker to influence.

name: clean_static_regex
reason: A $regex given a fully static, allowlisted pattern is not derived from request data.

name: clean_objectid_cast
reason: ObjectId(...) validates and casts the request value; request.args is never passed as the whole query filter.

name: clean_parseint_standalone
reason: The cast happens outside any query-filter call; this line alone builds no MongoDB query.

name: clean_string_cast_standalone
reason: A standalone cast assignment builds no MongoDB query on this line.

name: clean_shorthand_local_var
reason: Object shorthand referencing an already-validated local variable carries no colon-delimited request expression to flag.

name: clean_mongoose_schema_cast
reason: A mongoose-style call whose filter value is still explicitly cast closes off the operator-injection payload.

name: clean_regex_local_var
reason: $regex given an already-sanitized local variable (not a bare req.* token) is not the unsanitized-input shape this rule targets.

name: clean_json_parse_local_file
reason: JSON.parse() of a local file, not of req.body/req.query/req.params, does not deserialize attacker-controlled text into a query.

name: clean_prose_comment_mentions_where
input: # Historical note: migrated away from a raw $where clause to indexed queries.
reason: Bare prose mentioning $where with no colon-delimited string/f-string/concatenation must not be flagged.

name: clean_static_filter_no_request_data
reason: A fully static filter with no request-derived values at all has no injectable surface.
